blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — An Indian national died after he was hit by a Philippine National Railways (PNR) train in San Pablo City, Laguna Tuesday morning, according to the Calabarzon police. The victim was a 20-year-old businessman who was a motorcycle backrider. Initial investigation showed that upon reaching a railway crossing in Barangay Del Remedio at 6:37 a.m., the victim hopped off the motorcycle, still wearing his helmet. As he was crossing the railway tracks on foot, he was crushed by an approaching train. He was rushed by rescuers to San Pablo District Hospital, where he was declared dead on arrival. ...
